about: WP69 (mechanism B, the holdout-3 triage's page-spill levers): investigated, NOT shipped. The triage held that each source page ending in a hard page break makes a 1-3-line spill cost a whole page, and proposed levers to absorb it. Measured, none reaches the holdout-3 cases it was aimed at: their spills are layout-reconstruction errors (a memo's stamp/header block, a signature grid, URL wraps, resume samples read as two columns), not 1-3-line residuals. Coordinator decision 2026-10-13: shelve; branch wp69 (a6a6b2b on 2d7788c) kept unmerged for later.

a3_widow_control.tried: measured first (the one lever that also acts in Word): widow/orphan control on the body paragraphs of the target documents, LibreOffice and Word
a3_widow_control.result: moves no page in either renderer on any target case

a1_seam_join.tried: inference marks seams where the source's own page break cut a paragraph (same face/size/leading/indent, no list/heading/numbering/line breaks, the sentence runs on in lower case; infer._mark_joinable_seams); the writer may omit that page break so the overrun runs on (docxout._resolve_joins). Refine loop: join only where the render shows a spill the levers cannot take back (need > lever room) and the next page's measured room + gap holds it (refine._decide_joins), continuation lines reassigned to page n. Raw lane: open-loop rule (_seam_excess at the loop floors > 0 and _flow_balance of the pair <= 0). Never under gdocs, never two in a row.
a1_seam_join.result: zero loop joins on 202 documents (corpus, holdout-1/-2/-3); one open-loop join in the raw lane, y09 (below). None of the target cases is reachable: h3_17 page 2 opens with the memo's continuation header (seam not joinable); h3_14 page 1 does not spill (its spill is on page 2); h3_34 p6 need 138pt < lever room 203pt so the levers, not a join, own it; h3_01/h3_02/h3_32 have no joinable spilling seam.

b_word_reserve.tried: under the refine loop, a page the model keeps within one more body line of its box is paid that line from the gentle gap tier only (never floors), and the loop's pushes keep it (pagefit.WORD_SLACK, WORD_SLACK_LINES = 1.0): the model's rendered-minus-modelled height p90 is +13.7pt, one body line.
b_word_reserve.result: fixes h3_32 in Word (8 -> 7 pages); does not fix h3_01 (needs ~14.8pt, gentle budget 11.8pt). Gate regression: 01_whitepaper_market p2 keeps 22.3pt spare (inside the reserve) and the reserve moved its lines -- product within2pt 0.8128 -> 0.749 -- where Word needed nothing. Shipped OFF on the branch: nothing yet tells a page at risk in Word from one that is not.

a2_font_shrink.result: lines are exact-leading, so a shrink acts only through re-wrap, and only on LibreOffice spills the loop already sees and measures; no target case has a residual it would reach.

c3_word_fixture.result: not reproducible: both renderers set the page alike; no Word-only spill fixture exists.
